path_convention: Project paths are relative to candidate source; review and verification artifacts are relative to candidate root. Prior inputs use external-evidence labels.
review_method: Independent source-operation review plus read-only inspection of vendor originals, metadata, actual generated HAL and build/ELF artifacts. Reviewer ran no Cargo, tests, probes, models, harnesses, network or hardware.

own_ro_authority.sources: Own RM PDF58/59/61, own locked SVD, existing field-access policy, actual typed PAC; separate from layout-mask derivation.
